dedupe_keys.name: trustworthy and transferable water demand forecasting a cross country real world study replication package

description: Claudia Maussner and Erich Teppan publish a replication package for water-demand forecasting across Austria, Italy and California. Zenodo archives source code, input series and raw outputs from eighteen methods applied to 261 real demand series. The linked repository distinguishes MIT code from CC BY 4.0 data and identifies separate source terms for original Italian and Californian inputs. Austrian series are aggregated city and district inflows; the other partitions include processed district features and Californian supplier data. These series can calibrate demand forecasts or benchmark transfer between utilities before water-network simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined benchmark. A limitation is that daily features and aggregation remove household detail, and training several pretrained or deep models requires three Python environments. Archived results are study outputs, not evidence that one method works for every new utility. No archive was downloaded, and reported predictive scores were not reproduced.
